sobre.texto:
I'm Nay.

A gaúcha at heart, catarinense by choice. I came to Balneário Camboriú for a few days — and stayed six years. As it goes for those who truly belong somewhere.

But before I was here, the way I am today, there was a version of me who doubted. Who worked far from what she loved, who kept postponing her dream out of fear of not being good enough. Who looked at the art of beauty and thought: this demands so much, so much study, so much courage — am I capable?

I was. I just didn't know it yet.

The turning point didn't come with a perfect plan. It came through prayer. I went to a church here in Balneário, knelt down, cried and surrendered: 'God, let your will be done.' The next day, I received the proposal that changed my life — the opportunity to take over a salon and, with it, the dream I had buried too deep for too long.

I learned that day that when we let go of control and trust, things happen the way they're meant to.

Today, at 27, I wake up every day to do what I've always loved: work with women's self-esteem. Every client who leaves my chair different from how she arrived is my greatest result. There's no greater reward than that.

Naiara Colin Espaço de Beleza wasn't born overnight. It was born from courage, faith, and hard work — and from the certainty that a dream placed in the right hands, happens.

If you haven't been here yet, I invite you. This is your place.

privacidade.corpo:
Naiara Colin Espaço de Beleza, located at Rua 1500, 397 — Centro, Balneário Camboriú, SC, Brazil, processes your personal data in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law nº 13.709/2018).

**Data collected**
We collect only data voluntarily provided via WhatsApp or contact forms, such as name and phone number, for the purpose of scheduling services.

**Purpose**
Data is used exclusively for contact related to scheduling and delivery of salon services.

**Sharing**
We do not share your data with third parties, except as required by law.

**Your rights**
You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time via WhatsApp: +55 47 99792-3415.

**Cookies**
This website uses essential technical cookies for page functionality and analytics cookies (Google Analytics). You can disable analytics cookies in your browser settings.

**Contact**
Questions about this policy: contato@naiaracolin.com.br
